channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: New Stations of the Cross unveiled at St. Peter’s Basilica for Lent 2026
item.description: St. Peter's Basilica inaugurated a new Stations of the Cross Feb. 20, with paintings by a young Swiss artist who won the Vatican's international art competition and said in an interview with OSV News that he was deeply moved by the experience of painting St. Veronica's encounter with Christ.

item.title: God offers new possibilities, not prohibitions, with his invitation to love, pope says
item.description: While Satan tempts humanity with the lie of gaining unlimited power, God offers the gift of true freedom that leads to real love, relationships and fulfillment, Pope Leo XIV said.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV tells priests not to use AI to write homilies or seek likes on TikTok
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has urged priests to not to use artificial intelligence to write their homilies or to seek "likes" on social media platforms like TikTok.

item.title: St. Francis’ relics open to public for first extended veneration in 800 years
item.description: For the first time in eight centuries, the mortal remains of St. Francis of Assisi are being exposed for an extended period of public veneration, drawing hundreds of thousands of pilgrims from around the world to pray before "the Little Poor Man of Assisi."

item.title: Radio Interview: Holier matrimony
item.description: Exploring the beauty and challenge of Catholic marriage, this week’s episode of "Catholic Review Radio" features author and homeschooling mother Caitrin Bennett discussing her award-winning book, "Holier Matrimony: Married Saints, Catholic Vows and Sacramental Grace."

item.title: Myrtle Stanley, former director of what is now archdiocesan Missions Office, dies at 96
item.description: Myrtle Stanley, former director of the Archdiocese of Baltimore's Office of the Propagation of the Faith (now the Missions Office), died Feb. 6. She was 96.

item.title: Bishops urge prudence, prayer, invoke Guadalupe’s protection as violence erupts in Mexico
item.description: Mexican bishops called on the faithful to follow safety protocols as violence broke out in several states following the military's killing of a powerful cartel boss.

item.title: Pope renews ‘heartfelt appeal’ for ‘immediate ceasefire’ in Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has renewed his "heartfelt appeal" for an "immediate ceasefire" in Russia's war against Ukraine and again urged dialogue "be strengthened to pave the way toward peace."

item.title: At Curia retreat, Bishop Varden warns of Gospel’s use ‘as a weapon in culture wars’
item.description: The Lenten season is a reminder that Christians are called to bear witness to Christ through authentic witness, not self-righteous indignation, Norwegian Trappist Bishop Erik Varden told the pope and Vatican officials.

item.title: Movie Review: ‘Midwinter Break’
item.description: The validity of faith is a major theme in the sensitive marital drama "Midwinter Break" (Focus). As adapted from co-writer Bernard MacLaverty's 2017 novel by director Polly Findlay, the film is an exploration of how contrasting personalities and outlooks can serve either as a source of nuptial balance or of corrosive discord.
